description: This Java source file implements the DefaultAdapterResolver class, which contains logic for selecting the appropriate Adapter for a given Adaptable object within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes methods for dispatching based on enum attributes, handling ambiguity, and creating resolver functions.

classes.name: DefaultAdapterResolver
classes.description: Final class implementing AdapterResolver, responsible for resolving the correct Adapter for an Adaptable based on various attributes.

classes.name: ResolverStep
classes.description: Interface defining a step in the adapter resolution process, capable of combining current adapters with subsequent resolution steps.

classes.name: ForEnum
classes.description: Class representing a resolver step that dispatches based on an enum attribute of an adapter or adaptable.

classes.name: ForEnumOptional
classes.description: Class representing a resolver step that dispatches based on an optional enum attribute of an adapter or adaptable.

classes.name: EnumMapOrFunction
classes.description: Interface for evaluating dispatch strategies, either via an EnumMap or a Function.

classes.name: IsEnumMap
classes.description: Implementation of EnumMapOrFunction that uses an EnumMap for dispatching.

classes.name: IsFunction
classes.description: Implementation of EnumMapOrFunction that uses a single Function for dispatching.

classes.name: Bool
classes.description: Enum representing boolean states with utility methods for composing predicates.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns the Adapter for a given Adaptable by applying the resolver function.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Checks if an Adaptable's payload has a present status, indicating a response.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a list based on a predicate.

methods.name: throwUnknownTopicPathException
methods.description: Throws an UnknownTopicPathException for a given Adaptable.

methods.name: throwAmbiguityDetectedException
methods.description: Throws an IllegalStateException indicating ambiguous adapters.

methods.name: constantFunction
methods.description: Creates a constant function returning a specified result.

methods.name: dispatchByEnum
methods.description: Creates a dispatch strategy based on enum attributes of adapters.

methods.name: selectMatchedAdapters
methods.description: Selects a matching adapter from a list, or throws or returns a default.

methods.name: evalEnumMapByOptional
methods.description: Evaluates an enum map with optional enum extraction, providing a default for no match.

methods.name: evalEnumMap
methods.description: Evaluates an enum map based on an enum extractor function.

methods.name: forTopicPath
methods.description: Converts a TopicPath extractor into an Adaptable extractor.

methods.name: computeResolverRecursively
methods.description: Recursively builds the adapter resolver function based on resolver steps.

methods.name: computeResolver
methods.description: Builds the complete adapter resolver function from a list of adapters.
